listing.name: Full Spectrum System Scan 1.0.1
listing.summary: This mod adds a new ability called the "Full Spectrum System Scanner" which allows for your fleet to scan all the planets in a system without needing to visit each one. The Lunalib settings can be used to change nearly everything.
listing.aiSummary: Adds an ability to scan all planets in a system at once and deposit survey data into the cargo hold.

description:
Full Spectrum System Scan
A not-so-simple-anymore mod that adds a that will scan every planet in your current system and deposit
the survey data to your cargo hold.

Download
Source Code
Requires Lunalib
Can be safely added to Existing Saves. Can not be safely removed.

This mod adds a new ability called the "Full Spectrum System Scanner" which allows for your fleet to scan all the planets in a system without needing to visit each one.
The Lunalib settings can be used to change nearly everything. From how long it takes to complete to the cost in volatiles and/or combat readiness to activate.

Tooltip example:

Spoiler

Any bugs or requests should go to the GitHub where I will eventually get to them. Though yell at me in here if you catch a spelling or grammar error.
Do be warned, I started programing in java only a month ago as I though this would be "easy enough to make". So expect delays.

Credit to Frontier Developments for the Elite: Dangerous FSS Honk sound which took far too much effort to add.

Changelog

Spoiler
5/26/2026: Will no longer be keeping this public. There will be no more public updates. Sorry.
